agencyName: New York State Education Department, Office of the Professions
authorityRationale: NYSED Office of the Professions' own dedicated nursing-endorsement page, explicitly stating the Form 1 application fee for RNs/LPNs licensed elsewhere.
reliabilityRationale: Primary official, profession-specific endorsement page. Note: a separate, generic multi-profession NYSED fee chart (opfeechart.pdf) lists a differently-labeled '$50 Endorsement (Relocation)' line whose profession scope is unclear from context; the profession-specific nursing endorsement page is preferred as the more directly on-topic and unambiguous source, and this discrepancy is documented rather than silently ignored (see field notes).
